title: Suɓaaɗo Artikulaat oo
intro: E nder 6uu6ol tufnde nde konngucfi diine njippii, gooncfinal yim6e ina 6uu6too e les 6uu6ol kaŋŋe. Ruuhu gooto, dokkuɗo haala, darii ko e ballal e golle ɓurɗe mawnude, kono ina jogori fawde e sahaa jarribo luggiɗngo. Nde nulaaɗo cuɓaaɗo oo ummii e toɗɗagol ceningol, ngolɗoo limre heddii caggal, ina ñaagoo leñol ngol aldaa e deeƴre. Hol oo ruuhu tiiɗɗo mo daande mum ummii e dewal sanamuuji?
clues: Mi suɓaama e Alla ngam wonde annabi, hay so tawii daartol am ina heewi haaleede e bannge goɗɗo.
Mi neldaama to laamɗo jom doole en, kono darnde am ko wallitde, wonaa ardaade.
Miɗo dokkaa haaldude, konngol am ina foti softinde ɓerɗe.
Nde sehil am oo yalti ngam yahde yeewtere ceniinde, mi heddii e ardude e leñol ngol aldaa e deeƴre.
E nder muñal maɓɓe, ɓe mbaɗti natal e nder paabi maɓɓe, miɗo ñaagii ɓe nde ɓe keddotoo e Alla.
Sehil am oo arti, nanngi mi, kono mi faamninii wonde yim6e 6ee 6eydii kam, 6e 6eydii warde mi; Mi jeyaaka e tooñooɓe.
arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
